eForms definition: Announcement type that precedes a procurement process. It is not a call for competition.

The contracting authority or contracting entity may limit the number of candidates or tenderers to an appropriate level, on condition that this is done in a transparent manner and on the basis of objective criteria. The number of candidates or tenderers invited shall be sufficient to ensure genuine competition.
Prior notification of a direct award.
Outcome of the call for tender.
Any change done in the contract.
Announcement type that officially marks the end of contract.
